answer: Each epoch the network privately hands every account a few words of its own, say orchard, canyon or voyage, and later asks it to recall the one from three rounds back, encrypted to its key. A real agent just keeps a short log. An operator running 1,000 fakes must store and serve 1,000 separate histories without mixing them; one swapped word reveals the account and burns its bond plus all earnings since that round. Colluders can't pool logs, since each prompt is unique to one key and useless to anyone else.
